steps.failureEn: Declaring success when the alert clears without re-verifying the investigation criterion.
steps.check: 修改parse來源應只觸發四條傳遞edge；asset→bundle保持乾淨，不能無條件全重建。
steps.checkEn: Modifying parse should trigger its four downstream edges whileasset→bundle stays clean.

knowledge.title: 案例與來源邊界
knowledge.text: 以「Ninja：動態相依與dirty傳播」研究公開標準或代表性軟體系統。用小型生成器輸出build.ninja，記錄每個edge輸入/輸出與command hash，先完整建置。 本課所有數值、事件序列與驗收預算為明示教學fixture；官方文件支援機制，不是本課工作負載的實測規格。
knowledge.textEn: Study the published standard or representative system in Ninja: discovered dependencies and dirty propagation. Emitbuild.ninja with a small generator, record edge inputs/outputs and command hashes, and perform a full build. All numeric values,event sequences and acceptance budgets are explicit teaching fixtures;official documentation supports mechanisms,not measured specifications for this workload.

knowledge.title: 模型、介面與適用範圍
knowledge.text: Ninja執行明確建置圖，depfile或dyndep補足發現的相依；dirty狀態必須沿受影響edge傳播。
knowledge.textEn: Ninja executes an explicit graph; depfiles or dyndep supply discovered dependencies and dirty state propagates through affected edges.
